from build123d import *

main_pipe_diameter = 30.0
branch_pipe_diameter = 20.0
wall_thickness = 4.0
main_pipe_length = 80.0
branch_pipe_length = 40.0
chamfer_distance = 1.5

main_outer_radius = main_pipe_diameter / 2.0
branch_outer_radius = branch_pipe_diameter / 2.0
main_inner_radius = main_outer_radius - wall_thickness
branch_inner_radius = branch_outer_radius - wall_thickness

main_outer = Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(main_outer_radius, main_pipe_length)
branch_outer = Rot(-90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(branch_outer_radius, branch_pipe_length)
tee_outer = main_outer + branch_outer

main_inner = Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(main_inner_radius, main_pipe_length)
branch_inner = Rot(-90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(branch_inner_radius, branch_pipe_length)
tee_hollow = tee_outer - main_inner - branch_inner

part = chamfer(tee_hollow.edges(), chamfer_distance)
part.name = "tee_pipe_fitting"
export_step(part, "output.step")
